question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Famous
solution:
The correct answer is: **Obscure**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Famous** means known and recognized by many people.

 
 
• **Example -** *The actor was one of many **famous** faces at the party.*
 
 
 
• Marked option **Obscure** meaning is difficult to understand and likely to be understood by only a few people.
 
• **Example -** The **obscure** writer was not known in the literary community.
 
• It is clear that **'Famous'** and **'Obscure'** are opposite in meaning.
 
• Therefore the correct answer is **option 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Quiet** means absence of noise or bustle; silence; calm.
 
• **Concert** means a live music performance in front of an audience.
 
• **Affluent** means a person who is well-off financially.
